claims.object_text: mice lacking functional copies of the gene encoding the GluR3 AMPA receptor subunit (Gria3)
claims.quote: oligodendroglial lineage cells from mice lacking functional copies of the gene encoding the GluR3 AMPA receptor subunit (Gria3) had a diminished capacity to assemble edited GluR2-free AMPA receptors, and were resistant to excitotoxicity in vitro.

claims.object_text: Neurological deficits and spinal cord demyelination were substantially milder in Gria3 mutant mice
claims.quote: Neurological deficits and spinal cord demyelination elicited by immunization with myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein peptide were substantially milder in these Gria3 mutant mice than in their wild-type littermates.
